title: Harper Stash

sources.title: Grymforge
markers: | summary = The remains of an ancient underground fortress built around the legendary [[Adamantine Forge (location)|Adamantine Forge]]. It can be accessed by traversing the Ebonlake using a skiff at the [[Underdark]] beach.

sources.title: Sturdy
markers: | effects = * This material is rather strong. Only a hit that deals at least 10 damage can damage it.

summary: Reveal the Harper Stash by using the Toy Chest in Grymforge. It contains a Scroll of Evidence and a random spell scroll.

fields.Lock and trap: Use the Harper Key or a DC 20 Sleight of Hand check to unlock. Disarm with Light or DC 20 Sleight of Hand. Failing to disarm triggers Shatter, DC 10 Constitution for half damage.
fields.Defences and value: 25 HP. Sturdy requires 10 damage from one hit. Value is 195 gp before removing contents and 1 gp afterward.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
